The Lake Office offers concessions and some grocery items along with bagged ice.'; 'Contact the Lake Office (620-434-5554)'; links to '2024 Lake Fees' (docview.aspx?docid=29625), 'Current Regulations' (29622), the brochure (29627) and the campground map (28700) - none of them archived, and the live copies sit behind the same challenge, so the fees, booking and amperage stayed unread

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-05: at the stored pin 37.21435,-97.53014 (600 m half) the pin is at the lake office compound on the west shore; the west-shore campground loop centred ~37.2175,-97.5285 (160 m half) has a pad loop inside its loop road and, south of it, a group of RVs at ~37.2167,-97.5289 about 30-45 m from the shoreline across open grass with scattered trees and no road between. The stored waterfront_evidence point 37.2160,-97.5273 falls in open water (1,200 m frame), so it is not evidence; the east-peninsula campground (~37.2168,-97.5200) has a shoreline road between its main RV row and the water.

summary: Live city site is behind a Cloudflare challenge; Wayback 2025-11-02 copy confirms nearly 200 electric+water sites plus primitive areas, showers at both restrooms, concessions, permit required, closed in February (season 03-01..01-31 written). Fees, booking channel and amperage not readable (the 2024 fee sheet isn't archived). Lakefront supported by a fresh imagery read; the stored evidence point is in the water.
